summary: AEP Transmission Company, LLC filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for a public offering of senior unsecured notes, designated Series T, with principal amount, coupon, maturity and offering price left blank in the preliminary filing. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning 2027; notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with other unsubordinated debt and are effectively subordinated to secured debt. Optional make-whole and tax-credit-event redemptions at 101% are described. Joint book-running managers are BMO, BNY, Santander and Truist. Routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing and coupon.
